partition_vector_provenance.source: contracts/foundation-boundaries.md Browser SOCKS isolation identity — T136; independently computed with Python standard library, without importing or reading Go helper implementation; synthetic inputs only
command:
import hashlib, hmac, json
base = ("0f1e2d3c" * 4, "11" * 32, "abcd2345" * 7 + ".onion")
variants = {"base": base,
            "device": ("a1b2c3d4" * 4, base[1], base[2]),
            "site": (base[0], base[1], "wxyz2345" * 7 + ".onion"),
            "profile": (base[0], "22" * 32, base[2])}
for name, (token, profile, onion) in variants.items():
    message = json.dumps(["stargate-isolation-v1", profile, "normal", "firefox-default", "onion:" + onion], separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    print(name, "sg1:" + hmac.new(token.encode(), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest())
